other_conditions: Must be a student enrolled in a recognized school, institution or university
Must be at least 18 years of age
Preference is given to applicants who submit a clear Statement of Purpose (≤1000 words) indicating their area of interest
Applicants can apply for a maximum of three disciplines
Eligibility is limited to candidates pursuing specified courses such as Science, Forestry, Ecology, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Commerce, Economics, Management, Law, etc.
Applicants must submit supporting documents of qualification/enrolment and may submit additional skill‑set documents
benefits_summary: Interns receive a performance‑graded certificate and logistical support (transport, study material), but no monetary stipend.
documents_required: Proof of qualification or enrolment in an educational institute
